definitions.sale: A sale is an order with a payment date. It counts on the day it was paid (in the shop time zone), not when it was created.
definitions.tickets: Tickets are the order items that were sold, including tickets that were refunded later. Tickets replaced by a seat change are counted once.
definitions.revenue: Revenue is the gross price of the tickets plus service fees. With an event filter, only tickets and fees of the chosen events are counted; per-order fees cannot be assigned to an event and are left out. A tariff upgrade stays on the date of the original payment.
definitions.refunds: Refunds are successful refunds on the day they were processed (not pure overpayment refunds). Net revenue is revenue minus refunds.
definitions.currency: Only orders in the shop currency are added up.
